# QuerySolo

> An open-source warehouse for one machine, for SQL and dbt, available from source on macOS and Linux. DuckDB executes SQL, Apache Iceberg describes Parquet tables, and the gauge estimates supported catalog queries before execution. Scans without statistics are labeled Not estimated. CLI, desktop app, dbt runner, versions, S3 warehouse writes and table publishing, Lineage, Changes, and recovery guidance are available. Installers, cloud bursts, Team services, the ask box, and MCP are planned, not available.

## Pages
- [Home](/): interactive scan illustration, local workflow, actual app image, current feature status
- [The app](/app): the desktop app walkthrough
- [How it runs](/how-it-runs): query planning, four verdict states, local execution, and limitations
- [Medallion](/medallion): bronze / silver / gold on a laptop with a dbt project
- [For agents](/agents): available CLI and local API; planned MCP tools and permissions
- [Pricing](/pricing): Local free today; proposed Team and Burst pricing, clearly labeled as planned

## Developer docs (developer preview; describes the code in the repo, install from source)
- [Overview](/docs): what is built and what is not, versions
- [Install and quickstart](/docs/install): uv, init, import, sql, estimate, catalog serve, question save, audit network
- [The gauge](/docs/gauge): the verdict line, the rule, where the numbers come from, exit codes, history
- [Tables](/docs/tables): import matrix, type coercions to Iceberg, attaching Parquet in S3 without copying
- [The Iceberg REST catalog](/docs/catalog): catalog serve; DuckDB, pyiceberg, Spark and Trino as clients; the routes
- [Saved questions](/docs/questions): dbt models with two checks
- [Transactions and the catalog](/docs/transactions): what DuckDB-Iceberg refuses inside one transaction (CREATE OR REPLACE, drop-then-create, create-then-rename), why, and what it means for dbt
- [CLI reference](/docs/cli): every verb, generated from --help
- [querysolo.toml and the project folder](/docs/config): every setting, what init writes
- [The local HTTP API](/docs/api): querysolo serve, bearer token, routes, Arrow streaming
- [Developing QuerySolo](/docs/develop): the suite, opt-in Docker checks, contributing
- [The desktop app](/docs/app): running it from source, projects and windows, the Tables, Models and Gauge screens, Simple and Technical mode, the chart, settings, keys, how it talks to the core, nothing hidden
- [dbt and views](/docs/dbt): querysolo run, the DAG with verdicts, view models as Iceberg views in the catalog, what the plugin does
- [A real bucket](/docs/remote): what QuerySolo needs from AWS, credentials, the IAM policies, running the S3 tests against a real bucket, what they write and remove

- [Recovery](/docs/recovery): backups, interrupted writes, upgrades, and moving a project
